subject: re-st
title: RE.ST.------TRS.
description: Diagram in WAC-14, paired with v1-p216-1. (C)RE-ST (restructuralism — Braxton's term he prefers over 'innovation') is crossed with TRS (transition). The diagram poses what restructuralism's relationship to transition actually requires structurally — situated against Braxton's WAC-6 remark that restructuralism 'is the word I use instead of innovation since innovation does not semantically give enough emphasis on the progressive route of a given information readaptation.' Besides the main line to TRS, two branches leave the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and ALT-ACT (alternative activism). ALT-ACT carries INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) and AFI (affinity insight). INFO-AF-B branches to IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) and to INTR (interpretation) → AFTF (affinity transfer). AFI branches to INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics).
